title: Emmett Hughes delivers comfort with new single "I'll Always Be Around"
htmlContent:
From Huntington, New York, Emmett Hughes returns to the music scene with a hit that perfectly combines complexity with sincerity in "I'll Always Be Around," welcoming you with open arms.

On the surface, the message is sobering, and it is impossible to deny the feeling of joy it evokes. Life can be tough, but we always get through, through the good and bad times, we always have someone to hang on to. The title alone is enveloping in a warm Hughes hug, and there is something about this song that seems to scream Emmett Hughes.

https://open.spotify.com/track/1kRMMawJ1OO4tyy9x6ngBX

Where Hughes excels is in creating captivatingly straightforward tunes. Finding solace in the musical globe, especially when it comes to the melody that fills this space, isn't all that hard. The rich orchestration introduces an element of brilliance that is both unequaled and understandably captivating.

It is the honesty of "I'll Always Be Around" that makes it stand out. Hughes infuses warmth into his music, suggesting that he is singing to each one. This is not only the song to listen to if you want a good time, but it is also the song to listen to if you need an encouraging message. "I'll Always Be Around," Emmett Hughes's most recent song, is for you if you enjoy music that transcends genre and remains true to its honesty.
